name: Ripjaws
abilities: Enhanced strength (punches through docks, tears open Perplexahedron doors)
Underwater breathing and deep-sea pressure tolerance
Glowing anglerfish lure and glowing eyes
weaknesses: Dehydrates on land and can die without water; heat speeds this up
summary: Ben's aquatic ace: a grey anglerfish-man with a merman tail, crushing jaws and a lure light, unstoppable in water but gasping on land.
traits: Can swap between legs and a fish tail
OV design is hunched with a big dorsal fin
notableFeats: Helped the Krakken defeat Jonah Melville and recover her eggs (The Krakken)
Broke himself and Kevin out of a flooding Perplexahedron room (Perplexahedron)
Beat two Mechaneers underwater with Patelliday (Gone Fishin)
Defeated Vulkanus (The Ballad of Mr. Baumann)

appearances.designNotes: Pale grey body, purplish-grey eyes, yellow claws, swamp-green fins, gills down neck and torso, black patch on the left pectoral holding the original Omnitrix; loincloth when tail is retracted.
Catfish-like face with two whiskers, green eyes with pupils, white torso with Humungousaur-like chest plates, three-fingered black-clawed hands, green lure and lips, grey tail, Ultimatrix on chest.
Closer to the OS look but green eyes, arm and neck braces, green lure light, large dorsal fin, longer arm fins, hunched posture, black claws, bigger dragging tail, Omnitrix on a belt.

scoring.rationale: A monster in water - fast, strong, steel-biting - but almost helpless on dry land where he dehydrates within minutes, which is a crippling situational weakness.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (locked; unlocked off-screen in UA's Deep when the Ultimatrix scanned Piscciss Volann).
Also used by Kevin (Framed, photo only) - not counted.
Wiki describes an 11-year-old OV design (OS look with green eyes/Omnitrix) but Appearances lists no 11-year-old use; The Ballad of Mr. Baumann use is 16-year-old Ben.
